findings.title: AGENTS.md module header specification violation in three newly introduced Rust files
findings.recommendation: Add the mandatory concluding line `//! Keep this module focused on <a single responsibility>.` to each file's module documentation header.

findings.title: Schema parameter omission for persona_get and compose_context in published tool_schema pack
findings.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/schema_read_defs.rs:127-131 (persona_get has empty props while read_tools.rs:161-163 parses budget_tokens); crates/clio-mcp/src/schema_read_defs.rs:108-116 (compose_context props omit as_of, time_axis, expand_graph while read_retrieve.rs:134-136 parses them)
findings.recommendation: Declare budget_tokens in persona_get schema, and declare as_of, time_axis, expand_graph in compose_context schema (or remove parsing of undeclared properties from handlers), because schemas specify additionalProperties: false.

issues.title: AGENTS.md module header specification violation in three newly introduced Rust files
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md requires every Rust source file to have an exact module header structure ending with '//! Keep this module focused on <a single responsibility>.'. Missing this line violates the normative repository code standard.
issues.impact: Code style and consistency violation in production Rust crates (clio-store and clio-mcp).
issues.proposed_fix: Append `//! Keep this module focused on <a single responsibility>.` (with appropriate responsibility wording) to the header doc comments of postgres_inspect.rs, sqlite_inspect.rs, and read_retrieve.rs.

issues.title: Schema parameter omission for persona_get and compose_context in published tool_schema pack
issues.why_it_matters: All published MCP tool definitions enforce additionalProperties: false. If a handler parses parameters that are not defined in the schema, strict MCP client validators will reject client calls attempting to supply those parameters.
issues.impact: Clients passing budget_tokens to persona_get or as_of/time_axis/expand_graph to compose_context will fail JSON Schema validation.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-mcp/src/schema_read_defs.rs:127-131 has empty props for persona_get, but read_tools.rs:161-163 reads budget_tokens. Similarly, schema_read_defs.rs:108-116 omits as_of/time_axis/expand_graph for compose_context, while read_retrieve.rs:134-136 extracts them.
issues.proposed_fix: Add the optional property definitions to schema_read_defs.rs (budget_tokens for persona_get; as_of, time_axis, expand_graph for compose_context), or remove their extraction from the handler if intentionally unsupported over MCP.

issues.title: Attribution mismatch between developer task instructions and phase file
issues.why_it_matters: The task prompt explicitly mandated logging OpenCode CLI (Together . GLM-5.3 Flash High) in the phase attribution table, but the developer recorded OpenCode CLI (Go . Deepseek V4.1 Flash High).
issues.impact: Audit trail discrepancy in roadmap documentation.
issues.proposed_fix: Update line 6 of roadmap/phase-100170-mcp-read-retrieve-compose-surface.md to match the task instructions or record the reason for the variation.
